alerts.headline: Nightly from 10 p.m. to 5 a.m. the next day beginning Sunday, Aug. 30 to 5 a.m. Friday, Sept. 4, both directions of the State Route 167 on- and off- ramps at Ellingson Road (milepost 12) will close for utilities work. Starting Monday, Aug. 17, both directions of SR 169 in Black Diamond are closed between Southeast 332nd Street and Plass Road for 35 days for fish barrier removal. 

Separate signed detours will guide passenger vehicles and freight vehicles around the closure. 

Local access is permitted north and south of the closure, but through traffic must follow the signed detours. Businesses are open and accessible along SR 169 during this construction.

One lane will remain open in each direction.

Monday, Aug. 24, on select nights until Friday, Sept. 4 - The westbound SR 520 off-ramp to northbound I-5 and East Roanoke Street will close for construction beginning at 10 p.m. until 6 a.m. nightly on the dates of Aug. 24-27, Aug. 29, and Aug. 31-Sept. 3. All traffic that remains on westbound SR 520 past the Montlake exit will detour to southbound I-5 during the hours this ramp is closed.
The express lanes will operate northbound-only 24 hours a day until the end of the year, to support  Revive I-5 northbound construction.
The left express toll lane of southbound I-405 between Damson Road (milepost 29.0) and SR 522 (milepost 23.47) will be closed overnight from 11:59 p.m. Monday, Aug. 31 to 4:30 a.m. Tuesday, Sept. 1.
